'''Derek''' was a senior [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi apprentice]] during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]]. During the [[Battle of Uroro Station]] against [[Darth Caedus]], he served alongside [[Jagged Fel]] as a [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] on the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].
